events.text: I tested the induced draft motor with a multimeter. Voltage is present at the motor; the numerical reading was not recorded.
I removed the inducer motor and found it seized. My diagnosis is failed inducer motor; I also described the windings as bad, but no separate winding test was reported.
I told Miss Smith we can order the replacement today and plan a return visit within a week. She agreed. No order or appointment is confirmed.
